messages:
Amir (CS): heads-up — FinMetrics submitted an urgent escalation. They started seeing schema validation failures after today's rollout (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-17-09). They say nested objects inside 'orderItems' are sometimes returned as string blobs or empty strings, which breaks their strict ingest pipeline. customer request_id: r-8f3b2c

Sarah (CS): paste of customer validator error: 
ValidationError: orderItems[2].productId must be integer; got string

Amir (CS): customer provided expected vs actual. expected:
```json
{
  "orderId": 12345,
  "orderItems": [
    {"productId": 987, "qty": 2},
    {"productId": 654, "qty": 1}
  ]
}
```
actual (what they're receiving intermittently):
```json
{
  "orderId": 12345,
  "orderItems": [
    "{\"productId\": 987, \"qty\": 2}",
    {"productId": 654, "qty": 1},
    ""
  ]
}
```

Mike (Infra): any API/proxy changes this morning? content-type still application/json?

Amir (CS): proxy headers look normal from their logs. They sent the raw model output as we return it (no wrapper):
```json
{"orderId":12345,"orderItems":"[{\"productId\":987,\"qty\":2},{\"productId\":654,\"qty\":1}]"}
```
(note: sometimes it's an empty string in the array instead of an object)

Lisa (ML): which model/version rolled out? and was any structured-output postprocessing toggled?

Amir (CS): Model: rwd-v1.4.2, rollout to 100% at ~09:05 UTC. Canary at 50% earlier — canary logs didn't show flags for this customer, customer saw failures starting ~09:12 UTC. No explicit structured-output toggle in the deploy notes.

Lisa (ML): quick check: I ran the same prompt locally against rwd-v1.4.1 and rwd-v1.4.2. 1.4.1 returns proper JSON objects. 1.4.2 sometimes emits array elements as a single string token when the KV cache boundary aligns with nested braces — looks like the model is producing a stringified chunk, not the post-processor stringifying. Repro steps below.

Amir (CS): pasting customer's repro prompt (sanitized):
```json
{"prompt":"Generate order JSON for ingest. Include orderId and orderItems array with productId (int) and qty (int).","max_tokens":150,"temperature":0}
```

Tony (SRE): can we get a deterministic repro with seed/streaming turned off? If we can reproduce we can decide rollback vs patch. I'll open an incident and loop infra on rollback options. @oncall-sre will need to approve.

Mike (Infra): looking at autoscaler/logs — no infra failures. If it's model output-level we should avoid rolling back infra; we can pin customers to 1.4.1 via routing if needed. Can we confirm frequency? is it 100% of responses or intermittent?

Amir (CS): FinMetrics says ~20% of orders are affected since 09:12 UTC. High enough to blow up their ingest. They've asked for mitigation (rollback or pin) within 2 hours unless we provide a patch.

Lisa (ML): hypothesis: tokenizer/streaming boundary bug introduced in 1.4.2 that causes nested JSON to be emitted as a quoted string when large tokens split. I'll run a sweep against the canary and full rollout logs to confirm. If confirmed, patch will be in the runtime + a quick model pin.

Sarah (CS): customer wants an ETA and is requesting either a temporary pin to 1.4.1 or rollback. I'll ask them to hold on and will share any mitigation.

Tony (SRE): creating incident. If Lisa confirms root cause, we'll coordinate a targeted routing rule to pin FinMetrics to rwd-v1.4.1 and start a patch release for 1.4.2.

support-bot: Incident created INC-20260317-92 by Tony (SRE) — severity P1. Assigned: Lisa (ML), Mike (Infra).

Lisa (ML): next steps for me: (1) repro locally with seeded inputs and streaming off, (2) scan recent inference logs for patterns, (3) prepare a minimal fix or revert if patch not quick. Will post findings here within 30m.

Amir (CS): thanks — I'll keep FinMetrics updated and capture their failures + sample request_ids.

Sarah (CS): tagging priority: customer is revenue-impacting, legal/compliance not involved. Keeping channel open for updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
